name: August Diekhaut
original_name: アウグスト・ディックハウト
source:
Affiliation: ICSEO
Post: Supreme Ruler
Birthplace: Germany (Hamburg)

The highly charismatic supreme ruler of ICSEO who is admired by all his subordinates.
He was caught up in an incident in the past and assumed dead, but he barely survived and founded the ICSEO.
